description: The bar chart illustrates the Shapley values for different linguistic categories (L4+, L3, L2, L1, T, R1, R2, R3, R4+) in two multilingual BERT models, mBERT and XLM-R, as part of a morphosyntactic probing study. The horizontal axis represents the linguistic categories, while the vertical axis, labeled "Shapley value," indicates the magnitude of the values, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80. The bars are color-coded, with mBERT represented in light blue and XLM-R in dark blue. The tallest bar corresponds to the category "T," with mBERT showing a significantly higher Shapley value than XLM-R. The other categories have relatively low Shapley values, with mBERT generally showing higher values than XLM-R across the categories. The chart does not include any bars that are sorted, emphasized, or annotated in any specific way.
